description: This file contains a Go implementation of a CSI plugin translator for Azure File storage, including functions for translating between in-tree and CSI volume representations, handling volume IDs, and extracting storage account info.

classes.name: azureFileCSITranslator
classes.description: A struct implementing translation methods for Azure File CSI driver.

methods.name: TranslateInTreeStorageClassToCSI
methods.description: Translates in-tree Azure File storage class parameters to CSI storage class.

methods.name: TranslateInTreeInlineVolumeToCSI
methods.description: Converts an in-tree AzureFile volume to a CSI PersistentVolume.

methods.name: TranslateInTreePVToCSI
methods.description: Converts an in-tree PersistentVolume with AzureFile source to a CSI PersistentVolume.

methods.name: TranslateCSIPVToInTree
methods.description: Converts a CSI PersistentVolume with AzureFile source back to in-tree format.

methods.name: CanSupport
methods.description: Checks if the plugin supports a given PV.

methods.name: CanSupportInline
methods.description: Checks if the plugin supports a given inline volume.

methods.name: GetInTreePluginName
methods.description: Returns the name of the in-tree plugin driver.

methods.name: GetCSIPluginName
methods.description: Returns the name of the CSI plugin.

methods.name: RepairVolumeHandle
methods.description: Repairs or returns the volume handle, currently a no-op.

methods.name: getFileShareInfo
methods.description: Parses volume ID to extract resource group, storage account, share name, and disk name.

methods.name: getStorageAccountName
methods.description: Extracts storage account name from secret name using regex.
